intro.text: A corporal serving under Claude Aradel in the Elendel constabulary.

items.text: Maindew made a point of saluting Aradel, who found it fawning and told him not to bother indoors. When he saluted anyway during Aradel's meeting with Marasi, Aradel threw wadded-up broadsheets at his face, and Maindew apologized.
